selector.why: The specific finding of a pedunculated ureteral tumor with a vulnerable surface and the presence of a tubular filling defect with partial obstruction of the right mid ureter, as demonstrated by intravenous urography and retrograde ureteropyelography, decided it.

support_spans: Intravenous urography demonstrated a tubular filling defect with partial obstruction of the right mid ureter
Retrograde ureteropyelography confirmed a 5 cm long tubular mass in the mid ureter proximal to the iliac vessels
contradict_spans: Urine cytology and endoscopic biopsy of the lesion and renal pelvis were negative for malignancy
